reason: The lines relied on were reread on the native images with the Paris page images at hand, which guided the expansions, the reading of damaged formulas and the red 'super eodem' groups, and the placing of each piece in the sequence of tables.
sources: Paris, BnF, lat. 14174, fols. 19v-22r, Tractatus de variis modis componendi epistolam, preceded by the end of the Tabula narrandi petendi et concludendi (Gallica btv1b10034659b, page images from microfilm), https://gallica.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/btv1b10034659b
E. J. Polak, Medieval and Renaissance Letter Treatises and Form Letters, vol. 2 (2015), pp. 257, 264, 274, and vol. 3 (2023), p. 282 (Google Books snippets only)
Journal des savants (1899); description of a Barcelona or Tarragona copy; H. Kopičková, Listy na Husovu obranu (1999): title and incipit with Laurentius's name (Google Books snippets only)
L. Rockinger, Briefsteller und Formelbücher des eilften bis vierzehnten Jahrhunderts, p. 953 ff., Laurentius, Practica sive usus dictaminis (OCR text; companion work, not the text of the fragment)
text:
F-xnhr (Stams, Stiftsarchiv, Frg. 35). Source-assisted reading, 31 October 2026. A research reader reread on the native images, with page images of Paris, BnF, lat. 14174, fol. 22r at hand, passage A (35_2v middle column), passage B (35_1v middle) and passage C (35_1r upper part). An independent checker read passage D (35_4r main block) on the image before opening the Paris page at that place (fol. 20r, right column), and read the red rubric on 35_3r (passage E). Everything else (35_3v, the rest of 35_3r, 35_4v, 35_2r, the scraps) rests on the image-only first reading. Not a verified transcription; accuracy has not been measured.
Conventions: expansions in ( ), lost or supplied text in [ ], (?) doubtful, "..." unread, [red] rubric. Boxes are left,top,right,bottom in native pixels on 4912 x 7360 canvases. Reading order of the pieces, by the Paris text: 35_3v, 35_3r, 35_4v, 35_4r, 35_2r, 35_2v, 35_1v, 35_1r.

== E. Canvas 0 (Stams_STA_Frg_035_01r04r), 35_3r upper left, box about 280,2960,960,3100. Last black line of the tabula, then three red lines (incipit of the tractatus)
[black] ... [ex h]oc a me gratie munus repor[tabis]
[red] [...]l..c(?) ... Inc(ipit)(?) ...
[red] [...] d(e) Aquil(egia)(?) s(upe)r div(er)sis mo(dis)
[red] [componendi?] epistolas
Note: "d' aquil" and "s(upe)r div(er)sis mo(dis)" are clear; the forename and most of the first red line are lost at the cut edge or unresolved.

== C. Canvas 0, 35_1r upper part, box 2540,820,4200,1700
[Vest]ri honoris incrementum ... / nobis porrexistis dulcorosis sum plenus(?) ... / [con]cupito in intimis affectuose ... / exaudire [red] super eodem
[Pre]camina que ... / ... in principio porrigenda ad finem p[...] [red] super eodem
